snippet.title: ICARUS: Console Edition – Official Announce Trailer | Coming to Xbox & PlayStation in 2026
snippet.description:
The next drop zone: Console.

ICARUS - the brutal survival game from DayZ creator Dean Hall - is coming to Xbox and PlayStation in 2026.

Face savage storms, deadly wildlife and the unforgiving surface of a planet that wants you dead...

Build. Hunt. Survive. Together.

🔥 Wishlist ICARUS: Console Edition and prepare for your first drop!

Xbox: bit.ly/ICARUSXbox
PlayStation:bit.ly/ICARUSPlaystation
